workstream.title: Tactile controls / Design Kernel R05 recovery

human_intent: Recover the durable tactile-control and universal-selector knowledge into one authority-aware R05 packet: accepted/canonical laws, reconstructed specimens, candidate Design Kernel/material work, sound/input rules and negative visual knowledge; continue materially without redesigning or promoting Current/Human Accepted/Served state.
already_decided: controls-v9 is a RECONSTRUCTED visual reference; authentic original V9 bytes remain unavailable and it is not Human Accepted authority.
controls.physical_material has human_accepted=null in the capability registry; recovery must not manufacture an accepted exact control artifact.
interaction.touch-first/SPEC.md is the canonical shared rule owner and names shared/interaction/touch-first/v1 as Current implementation.
touch-first v2 is CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED and cannot supersede v1 without representative consumer browser tests plus Human acceptance.
Design Kernel v2 and Physical Material v2 are candidates; their reusable law is separation of neutral tokens from material and depth only for manipulability.
material.bicolor v1 is candidate-integrated, not globally Human Accepted; its contract is exactly two theme colors, relief only on manipulable controls, geometric depth and no color-mix helper tones.
selector V45 is a lab specimen. Its theme and sound-profile names are evidence/candidate ideas only unless another authoritative owner corroborates them.
Do not mutate V9/V45 or shared owner bytes merely to document or recover R05.
high_value_targets: Leave one durable matrix that prevents reconstructed V9, selector V45 and candidate shared material from being misreported as Human Accepted or Current.
Preserve the canonical touch-first grammar separately from visual/material candidates.
Recover the strongest bicolor/physical-control laws without copying contradictory free-accent or multi-tone implementation details from reconstructed specimens.
Record sound-profile evidence truthfully: observed selector profiles are not a canonical sound contract.
Make future controls work route to existing shared owners instead of rebuilding pointer, material, palette or gesture infrastructure locally.
known_failures: Treating a numerically newer selector/control version as authority.
Calling reconstructed V9 authentic or Human Accepted.
Promoting touch-first v2 over current v1 without the stated browser/human gate.
Applying relief to pages, cards, shells or non-manipulable content.
Using third decorative colors, helper tones or color-mix output inside the strict bicolor material owner.
Copying V9's free accent wheel into the bicolor owner and thereby violating the two-color contract.
Promoting V45 sound names to a shared sound system without durable authority or acceptance evidence.
Requiring hover, tiny precision targets, hidden scrollbars, UA branching or custom touch inertia.
Letting a drag also activate the tapped item or letting pointer capture survive cancellation/teardown.
Refactoring Calendar, P4 Capture or Navigator merely to make R05 look integrated.

workers.frontier: R05 recovery is materially consolidated. Future work routes input mechanics to interaction.touch-first and visual material to the smallest relevant existing shared owner; do not promote Current/Human Accepted/Served without the declared gates.
workers.last_useful_delta: Persisted an authority-aware R05 matrix separating canonical touch v1, gated touch v2, candidate Design Kernel/Material/bicolor owners, reconstructed controls V9 and selector V45 lab sound/theme evidence; also preserved the V9-vs-bicolor contradiction and twelve negative-knowledge rules.

useful_delta: R05 now has a durable authority matrix separating canonical shared input law, candidate shared visual/material owners, reconstructed V9 evidence and V45 lab-only ideas.

The V9-versus-bicolor contradiction is resolved for future integration: preserve corroborated physical affordance observations, but do not transplant V9's free-accent/multi-role palette into strict material.bicolor.
touch-first authority is explicit: SPEC is canonical, v1 is Current by owner spec, v2 remains CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED behind browser + Human acceptance gates.
Selector V45 sound profiles Oiled/Machine/Snap/Brown/Relay/Soft are durable evidence only; no R05 source promotes them to canonical shared sound ownership.

Twelve negative-knowledge rules now guard against authority inflation, global raised surfaces, decorative third colors, hover/precision dependencies, duplicated gesture stacks and drag-triggered activation.
Cross-workstream tactile routing was published as DELTA_FEED D-015 at global revision 15.
decisions: No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or Lineage pointer changes are justified by R05 recovery.
controls-v9 remains RECONSTRUCTED; authentic original V9 bytes remain unknown/unrecovered.
controls.physical_material has no registered Human Accepted exact artifact.
interaction.touch-first owns reusable pointer/gesture mechanics; product pages must not create competing generic adapters where that owner applies.
Strict two-color physical material routes to material.bicolor candidate ownership; Design Kernel v2 and Material v2 remain candidates rather than global skins.
Sound-profile experimentation remains candidate/local until an authoritative shared sound owner or explicit acceptance evidence is recovered.
shared_discoveries: Calendar, Capture, Navigator and future page workers should treat interaction.touch-first as the canonical interaction law while preserving each product's own skin/ownership.

The bicolor shared extraction is candidate-integrated even though its README says it derives from accepted Calendar language; shared extraction acceptance must not be inferred from source-language acceptance.
A reconstructed visual specimen can donate corroborated mechanism evidence without donating literal palette implementation or authority status.
negative_knowledge: Do not use a higher version number as authority.
Do not call reconstructed V9 authentic or Human Accepted.
Do not promote touch-first v2 over v1 without its declared representative browser + Human acceptance gate.
Do not raise page/content/shell surfaces by default; depth communicates manipulability.
Do not synthesize decorative third colors/helper tones inside strict bicolor material.
Do not transplant V9's free accent wheel into material.bicolor.
Do not turn V45's sound/theme lists into shared canon from lab evidence alone.
Do not require hover, tiny precision, hidden scrollbars, UA branches or custom touch inertia.
Do not let drag/scroll also activate the touched item.
Do not refactor Calendar, P4 Capture or Navigator merely to make tactile primitives look uniform.
unresolved: Authentic original controls V9 bytes remain CHAT_ONLY_UNKNOWN as an exact historical artifact.
No Human Accepted exact controls.physical_material artifact is registered.
A canonical/accepted shared sound owner for the V45 profile names was not established by the inspected R05 authority sources.
touch-first v2 and shared material candidates still require their declared representative consumer evidence and/or explicit Human acceptance before promotion.
last_return.human_boundary: Only authentic historical recovery or explicit Human acceptance/promotion decisions can close the remaining authority gaps; R05 has no truthful repository-only substitute for those events.
evidence: interaction.touch-first/SPEC.md: CANONICAL SHARED RULE; Current implementation v1.
touch-first/v2/MANIFEST.json: CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED with representative-consumer-browser-tests + Human acceptance promotion gate.
material.bicolor/v1/MANIFEST.json: candidate-integrated; exactly two theme colors; relief only manipulable; no color-mix helper tones.
Design Kernel v2 and Physical Material v2 are explicitly candidate documents.
Reconstructed V9 visibly uses a free accent wheel and more than two visual roles, proving literal transplantation would conflict with strict bicolor ownership.
Selector V45 source contains sound profile names Oiled, Machine, Snap, Brown, Relay and Soft but no R05 authority record promoting that list.
last_return.next_best_action: Consume R05 as a routing/evidence packet. For any concrete tactile defect, change only the smallest existing owner: interaction.touch-first for pointer/gesture mechanics, material.bicolor or another declared material owner for physical skin, and the product owner for product-specific appearance. Require the existing promotion gates before changing Current/Human Accepted/Served state.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen
